_note: The 8 fixed CleanScene channels. Client conversations stay in Jobber. Hours and pay never go in Slack except #management.

channels.name: announcements
channels.topic: Company news from Adam. Read only.
channels.purpose: Policy changes, holidays, training, wins worth sharing. Only Adam and the manager post here.
channels.pinned: How we use Slack: 1) Read #announcements. 2) Check #schedule before every shift. 3) Grab extra shifts in #open-shifts. 4) Problems on site go to #wins-and-issues right away, with a photo. 5) Clients never message you on Slack; anything a client says goes into Jobber.

channels.name: schedule
channels.topic: Tomorrow's jobs and any changes. The Jobber app is the source of truth.
channels.purpose: Manager posts the next-day schedule by 6 pm and every same-day change.
channels.pinned: Your visits, addresses, access notes and checklists are in the Jobber app. This channel only announces changes. If Slack and Jobber disagree, Jobber wins; tell the manager.

channels.name: open-shifts
channels.topic: Extra shifts that need cover. Reply if you are available; the manager assigns.
channels.purpose: Manager posts uncovered visits. Staff say they are available; the manager picks who works it.
channels.pinned: Shifts are assigned, not first-come. Reply 'Available' in the thread. The manager picks who works it and assigns them in Jobber; you are on the shift only once it shows in your Jobber app. Post format: Region / Date / Time / Site (no full address) / Est. hours / Type of clean.

channels.name: leads
channels.topic: New leads from Facebook and Jobber requests (automatic).
channels.purpose: Zapier posts every new lead. Adam claims it with an eyes emoji and quotes within 24 hours.
channels.pinned: Every post here already exists as a Request in Jobber. Work it in Jobber, not here. React :eyes: when you start, :white_check_mark: when the quote is sent.

channels.name: wins-and-issues
channels.topic: Quotes won, compliments, complaints, damage, lockouts, supply shortages.
channels.purpose: Anything that went especially well or wrong on a job. Photo + site + what happened.
channels.pinned: Issue format: Site / What happened / Photo / What you did. The manager logs a note on the client in Jobber. Damage or injury: call the manager first, then post.

channels.name: yellowknife-team
channels.topic: Yellowknife crew: day-to-day chat, keys, vehicles, supplies.
channels.purpose: Everything local to the Yellowknife crew.
channels.pinned: Supplies running low? Post the item and site here by Thursday for Friday restock.

channels.name: bc-team
channels.topic: Richmond/Vancouver crew: day-to-day chat, keys, vehicles, supplies.
channels.purpose: Everything local to the BC crew.
channels.pinned: Supplies running low? Post the item and site here by Thursday for Friday restock.

channels.name: management
channels.topic: Adam + manager only. Hours, payroll, staffing, escalations.
channels.purpose: The only channel where hours or pay are discussed.
channels.pinned: Members: Adam and the manager only. Never paste pay rates or client payment details here; link to the Hours Tracker or Jobber instead.
